deliveries.title: Delivery scheduling
deliveries.description: Propose delivery dates for your open purchase order lines. Procurement confirms each ETA.

deliveries.notSharedDesc: Your EPC contact hasn’t shared delivery scheduling with your account.
deliveries.couldntLoadDesc: Something went wrong. Please try again.
deliveries.emptyDesc: Delivery scheduling appears here once a purchase order is issued to you.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Upload a PDF invoice against a purchase order. It lands straight in the buyer's three-way match queue.

invoices.emptyDesc: Upload your first invoice above to start the match.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Two-way exchange: send datasheets and certificates, and read what your buyer publishes to you.

documents.sharedByUsEmpty: You have not shared any documents yet.
